_comment: Tier 1 regression gate, enforced in CI by `python -m dossier.eval.floors` against the
committed mini corpus. Floors sit a little below the values measured when they were
committed, so an ordinary chunking or fusion tweak does not trip them but a real
regression does. Raise a floor deliberately, in the same commit as the change that
earns it -- never to make a red build go away.
Measured at commit time on tests/fixtures/mini_corpus (20 questions, 4 documents):
vector nDCG@10 0.1362 / R@10 0.45; rrf(all three)+rerank nDCG@10 0.0923 / R@10 0.35;
